name: 薰衣草紫静音电动吸奶器款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: lavender-tinted plaster wall with one round openwork screen as the only depth element; seamless pearl-white plaster surface beneath the product
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft 5200K frontal key with gentle fill, very low contrast, short soft contact shadow, no hard specular hotspot, calm quiet mood

styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, thin light weights, generous letter spacing, headline plus short labels only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin silver-grey ring outlines with a single solid dot nested at each ring center, uniform hairline stroke, no filled or gradient icons
styleLock.presentationRules: product always fully visible with a firm contact shadow, verticals kept truly vertical, stable centered scale, transparent parts show real refraction and edge highlights
noDrift: no palette changes, hex only, no color-name adjectives
no mixed fonts, no serif, no handwritten, no retro cartoon lettering

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft lavender mother-and-baby ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pearl-white base #F8F6F3, lavender plaster #CFC4E0, silver-grey #B9BDC4 and one deep-violet accent #6B5A85; neutral 5200K soft frontal lighting with low contrast and short soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif in thin light weights; background of lavender-tinted plaster wall with one round openwork screen; thin silver-grey ring icons each carrying a single solid dot at the center; stable product scale, centered placement, truly vertical verticals; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源 6 片，归档 _sources/吸奶器。panel-01 竖排卖点作首屏，panel-02 的图标位与 panel-03/04/05 重复的档位说明合并为痛点镜与对比镜，panel-06 的会员二维码屏弃用改为收口镜。品类判定：图为蛋形主机＋透明喇叭罩＋集乳瓶与按键面板，属电动吸奶器，落 母婴/喂养（文件夹名一致）。风格取自源页浅紫底、白卡圆角、细环图标与低反差正面光。已剥离品牌、二维码与全部数值表述。
